verdict.rationale: Temporal's Cloud CLI extension documents managing Service Accounts and API keys. That shows first-party, non-human credential issuance an agent could use. The evidence never says these credentials can be scoped to particular permissions or namespaces, so the least-privilege part is unproven. missing for 10: documented permission/role scoping for API keys or service accounts, namespace-level least-privilege controls, agent-specific credential guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Use the extension to manage your Temporal Cloud control plane resources, including Namespaces, Users, Service Accounts, API keys, and perform other operational and administrative tasks.
